# Security Policy & Vulnerability Reporting

C.O.P.P.E.R. takes user privacy, zero-trust data firewall protection, and local execution security seriously.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1.0.x | Yes |
| < 1.0.0 | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability (such as a Data Firewall PII leak, arbitrary code execution in tool runners, or authorization bypass), please report it privately:

1. **Email:** Send details to **security@copper-ai.org**
2. **Details to include:**
   - Proof of Concept (PoC) script or detailed reproduction steps.
   - Affected component (Data Firewall, Agent Execution Engine, REST API, WebSocket Endpoint).
   - Impact assessment (e.g. unredacted PII egress to cloud model).

## Response Timelines

- **Initial Acknowledgment:** Within 24 hours.
- **Triage & Severity Assessment:** Within 48 hours.
- **Patch Release:** High/Critical severity issues patched within 7 days.

Please do not disclose security issues publicly until a patch has been released.
